title: Miss Valentina Chapeau - Alias Sharpe Shaposhnikoff-Chapeau

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SECRET
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY File No. 4025）
Special Branch Station:
Date Sept. 24 1932.

Subject (in full) Miss Valentine Chapeau, alias Sharpe, alias Shaposhnikoff-
Chapeau.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by O.B. Kn. Si.

With reference to the letter dated September 16, 1932,
from the Netherlands Consulate-General on the subject of Miss
Valentine Chapeau, enquiries show that she is a Russian born in
1911 at Libau, which formerly belonged to Russia but is now
part of Esthonia.

In 1920 she left Vladivostok and proceeded to Nagasaki
where she entered the "Convent of Holy Infant Jesus". She
studied in this institution until January 1923 when she went
to Shanghai in company with her mother. Here she joined the
Hanbury School for Girls which she attended until 1925 when she
left owing to financial difficulties of her parents who, it is
said, were unable to pay for her tuition.

From October 1925 to August 1926 she was employed as an
operator with the Shanghai Telephone Co. where she was known
under the name of Miss Sharpe, Rumanian. During this period
she was inclined to live above her means and developed the habit
of signing "chits" thereby causing considerable trouble to her
mother, who at that time resided at Chungking, and to her
guardian, Dr. G. Carnet.

It is reported that after the death of her mother,
Raisa Fedorovna Shaposhnikoff nee Letnikoff, in 1927, Dr.
G. Carnet - American of Russian Jewish extraction - a man of a
doubtful reputation, became Chapeau's paramour. It is also
reported that she was "kept" at various times by different men
in Shanghai, and that she has been frequently seen in company
of foreign naval officers.

In 1931 she was employed for some time at the "Lotus
d'Or", a curio shop owned by Mr. D'Auxion de Ruffe, local
French lawyer. She visited Manila on one occasion and in

特别股分站：
日期 1932年9月24日。

主题（全称）瓦伦丁·夏波小姐（Miss Valentine Chapeau），别名夏普（Sharpe），别名沙波什尼科夫-夏波（Shaposhnikoff-Chapeau）。

撰写人：D.S. 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky）。呈报人：O.B. Kn. Si.

关于荷兰总领事馆1932年9月16日来信提及瓦伦丁·夏波小姐一事，经查询显示，她是一名俄罗斯人，1911年出生于利鲍（Libau），该地原属俄罗斯，现为爱沙尼亚的一部分。

1920年，她离开符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴），前往长崎，进入“圣婴耶稣修道院”（Convent of Holy Infant Jesus）。她在该机构学习至1923年1月，随后与其母一同前往上海。在此，她进入汉伯里女子学校（Hanbury School for Girls）就读，直至1925年因父母经济困难而辍学，据称其父母无力支付她的学费。

1925年10月至1926年8月期间，她在上海电话公司担任接线员，当时以罗马尼亚籍夏普小姐（Miss Sharpe, Rumanian）之名为人所知。在此期间，她倾向于过超出其经济能力的生活，并养成了签“白条”（chits）的习惯，从而给当时居住在重庆的母亲及其监护人 G. 卡内特博士（Dr. G. Carnet）带来了不少麻烦。

据报道，在其母亲赖萨·费多罗夫娜·沙波什尼科娃（Raisa Fedorovna Shaposhnikoff，婚前姓莱特尼科夫 Letnikoff）于1927年去世后，G. 卡内特博士——一名具有俄裔犹太背景的美国人，声誉不佳——成为了夏波的情夫。另有报告称，她在上海不同时期被不同的男人“包养”，且经常被人看到与外国海军军官在一起。

1931年，她曾在“金莲”（Lotus d'Or）古玩店工作了一段时间，该店由当地法国律师 D'Auxion de Ruffe 先生所有。她曾去过一次马尼拉，并在

April 1932 made a pleasure trip to Japan where she met her friend,
Mr. H. Pedersen, employee of the Public Health Department, S.M.C.
It is believed that her correct name is Valentine
Shaposhnikoff. In 1927 she registered with the Russian Emigrants
Committee, No.6-A Hongkong Road, stating that her name was
Valentine Shaposhnikoff-Chapeau, that she was born on August 16,
1911, at Nice, France, and that she was a graduate of the
Hanbury School. According to her, her father A.I. Chapeau,
died in 1921 and her mother married one A.B. Shaposhnikoff who
died later in Japan in 1925. These data contradict her own
statement made to the local Japanese Consular Police when she
applied for a passport vise in April 1932, and stated that her
father A.I. Shaposhnikoff died in the U.S.S.R. in 1925.
To one of her friends she told that her father was a
French or Greek lawyer who committed suicide several years ago
in Japan.
It is believed that she adopted the name "Chapeau"
because she considers it more convenient to have a French
name in Shanghai.
Miss Chapeau speaks Russian, French, English and Japanese
languages.
She resides in apartment 16, No.43 Peking Road, a
boardinghouse owned by a certain American, named Sheek.

(批：Cies B.)

1932年4月去日本进行了一次休闲旅行，在那里会见了她的朋友、工部局公共卫生处的雇员 H. 佩德森先生（Mr. H. Pedersen）。
据信她的真名是瓦伦丁·沙波什尼科娃（Valentine Shaposhnikoff）。1927年，她在香港路6-A号的俄国侨民委员会登记，声称其名为瓦伦丁·沙波什尼科娃-夏波（Valentine Shaposhnikoff-Chapeau），1911年8月16日出生于法国尼斯，且为汉伯里学校毕业生。据她称，其父 A.I. 夏波（A.I. Chapeau）于1921年去世，其母后来嫁给了 A.B. 沙波什尼科夫（A.B. Shaposhnikoff），后者于1925年在日本去世。这些数据与她本人在1932年4月申请护照签证时向当地日本领事警察所作的陈述相矛盾，当时她声称其父 A.I. 沙波什尼科夫（A.I. Shaposhnikoff）于1925年在苏联去世。
她曾告诉一位朋友，她的父亲是一位法国或希腊律师，几年前在日本自杀身亡。
据信她采用“夏波”（Chapeau）这一姓氏，是因为她认为在上海拥有一个法国姓氏更为方便。
夏波小姐通晓俄语、法语、英语和日语。
她居住在北京路43号16室公寓，该寄宿舍由一位名叫希克（Sheek）的美国人所有。

（批注：抄送 B.）

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 2576.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
N. D 4025
Date 16.9.32

SHANGHAI, 16 September 1932.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Miss
Valentine CHAPEAU , of no occupation, born in
Nice (France) 16 July 1911, living at 43 Peking
Road, Appt. 16, an ex-Russian, intends to proceed
to Netherlands India on a pleasure trip.

I would be pleased to know whether anything
is known from a political or moral point of view
against this person.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Chinese Secretary.

Ds: Tchananshansky
T.P. Givens, Esquire, 8/9/19
Officer in charge of Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

S2,
For attention
please.
JHS
16.9.32

日期 1932年9月16日

上海，1932年9月16日。

先生：

谨此通知阁下，瓦伦丁·夏波小姐（Miss Valentine CHAPEAU），无业，1911年7月16日出生于法国尼斯，居住于北京路43号16室公寓，前俄国人，拟前往荷属东印度进行休闲旅行。

若能获悉从政治或道德角度是否有任何不利于此人的记录，我将不胜感激。

谨致
敬礼，

您的恭顺仆人，

中文秘书。

Ds: Tchananshansky
T.P. Givens 先生，19/9/8
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别股主管警官，
上海。

S2，
请予关注。
JHS
1932年9月16日
